{{Quote|You want my help? Then you help me, first. The palace scouts say that my sister left to come back here several hours ago... but she hasn't shown up. I fear the worst. Can you run to the edge of town and see if you can find my sister? Bring her back here to me?"<br />"Your sister?"<br />"Feinu. She runs errands for me. Mostly she delivers new equipment to Jabba's elite guard. Jabba and I have an agreement of sorts. The road from here to there is pretty dangerous. Valarian is always trying to mess things up. I worry that they have done something bad to Feinu. Will you go find her for me?"<br />"Yes. I will find her and bring her back here unharmed.|Palu Zerk and a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Feinu Zerk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] townsperson from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the younger sister of [[Palu Zerk]], both of whom ended up working for [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Working as a delivery [[Courier/Legends|courier]] for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] elite guard, Feinu at one point found herself ambushed by thugs of the rival [[Valarian Syndicate]] who attempted to kidnap her and hold her for [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]]. Before they could follow through with their plan, she was rescued by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] dispatched by her sister in nearby [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]]. As the spacer safely escorted Feinu back to [[Palu's shop]] in Wayfar, Feinu vowed to one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] enact revenge against the [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ahh&hellip; thank you so much for helping me! Those thugs would have disintegrated me for sure!"<br />"How did they get a hold of you?"<br />"They caught me on the way back from the palace. My sister says I shouldn't walk the road to Wayfar by myself. Valarian's thugs jumped me and told me they were going to hold me for ransom.|Feinu Zerk and her rescuer|<ref name="AED" />}}
As the younger sister of [[Palu Zerk]], Feinu Zerk was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="AED" /> townsperson from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="JTL" /> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], both Feinu and her sister ended up in the small [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="AED" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the two sisters formed a business agreement with the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal enterprise]] led by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Working from her [[Palu's shop|shop]] in Wayfar, Palu tailored specially designed [[Disease/Legends|disease-resistant]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and other high-quality garbs exclusively for Jabba's elite forces. Feinu would then deliver this newly created equipment to Jabba's elite guard on the short, yet dangerous road from Wayfar to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Feinu traveled the road alone, despite her older sister's objections. Their arrangement drew attention and ire from Jabba's rival, [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]. During one of her treks back from the palace, Feinu ended up running late. When Palu learned from the palace [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] that she had left to come back several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] ago, she began to fear the worst, and rightly assumed that the [[Valarian Syndicate]] may be involved in her disappearance.<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Fortunately for Palu, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who visited her shop agreed to search the edge of town to locate her sister. As it turned out, Feinu was indeed ambushed by a group of three Valarian thugs directed by a Valarian [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] leader. The Valarian thugs warned Feinu that if she moved, they would disintegrate her on the spot. She screamed for help as the gang attempted to kidnap her and hold her for [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]]. Before they could follow through with their plan, however, the spacer dispatched by Palu spotted the troubled young lady, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the four thugs who were attacking her. Feinu thanked her rescuer, and as the spacer escorted her back to Palu's shop in Wayfar, she vowed to one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] enact revenge against the Valarian swoopers. Once Feinu was safely back in town, her older sister expressed her sincerest gratitude. In thanks, she provided the spacer some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a [[Treated Protective Coverall]], a special suit which was resistant to disease. The spacer required such a suit in order to acquire corrosive [[Sarlacc bile|bile]] from the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. The spacer required the bile as a constructive component for the [[Zicx-bug bomb]]. However, gifting the spacer such a suit was an especially risky prospect for Palu. Because of her exclusive agreement with Jabba's elite guard, Palu knew that if Jabba found out that she gave the suit away, the Hutt crime lord would have the two of them killed. For this reason, she urged the spacer to leave her be, despite being grateful to individual for saving her younger sister.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Take me to my sister, please! We'll get revenge on these Valarian swoopers some day!|Feinu Zerk, to her rescuer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Feinu Zerk had fair skin, blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown eyebrows, and brown [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. When Valarian gang members threatened Feinu and attempted to kidnap her, Feinu was fearful and begged for help. However, she also thought of others, and worried about any passers by who might get caught in the crossfire. Feinu was greatly thankful to the spacer who had rescued her. After the attempt on her person, Feinu expressed something of a vengeful demeanor. She told her rescuer that she and her sister would one day enact revenge against the Valarian swoopers.<ref name="AED" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Thank you so much! Here&mdash;please take this special suit. It is resistant to disease. Jabba's scouts use this type of equipment whenever they're around the Sarlacc. It keeps them alive.|Palu Zerk, to the spacer who rescued her sister|<ref name="AED" />}}
During her journey from Jabba's Palace to Wayfar, Feinu wore a flex-form [[shirt]] colored in two shades of gray. She also wore a similarly colored pleated skirt and gray dress slippers. During her treks to and from Jabba's Palace, Feinu would deliver specially tailored disease-resistant clothing and other high-quality garbs for Jabba's elite forces. However, Feinu elected to go unarmed during these dangerous delivery trips.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|How could you have let this happen?! Oh, no&hellip; no&hellip; no&hellip; What am I going to do, now?|Palu Zerk, to players who failed to rescue Feinu|<ref name="AED" />}}
Feinu Zerk was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> She was included as part of the [[W:c:swg:Zicx Bug Bomb quest|Zicx-bug bomb quest]],<ref name="AED" /> added to the game on [[August 12]], 2003.<ref name="Publish">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64185&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2003}}</ref> During one part of the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]], players were required to locate Feinu, save her from four [[W:c:swg:Valarian|Valarian]] thugs, and escort her safely back to Palu in the [[W:c:swg:City|town]] of [[W:c:swg:Wayfar|Wayfar]]. Completing this task would earn the player 100 [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credits]] and a Treated Protective Coverall. The coverall could then be used for the next portion of the quest, allowing players to acquire [[W:c:swg:Jar of Sarlacc Bile|bile]] from the nearby [[W:c:swg:Sarlacc|sarlacc]] without suffering ill-effects. Feinu's surname of Zerk never appeared in the game.<ref name="AED" /> However, the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' ([[2004]]) lists her full name as Feinu Zerk. The reference guide also lists her as a townsperson found on [[W:c:swg:Rori|Rori]].<ref name="JTL" /> This attribute never appeared in the game, as Feinu only appeared as part a quest issued on [[W:c:swg:Tatooine|Tatooine]]. Although the player could choose not to do the tasks associated with the Zicx-bug bomb quest, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="AED" />
